name: Kimi no Naka no Palladium
original_name: 君の中のパラディアーム
source:
There is a world called Palladium, ruled by God with black wings and God with white wings. The world used be united, but it is now divided into two regions. The main character is Aile, who has been living at an orphanage. But one day, he leaves there and is saved by Ventvert, who says he is Aile's older brother, when Aile is lying by the roadside. Ventvert offers Aile to collect their separated brothers together…

[Edited from ErogeShop]
translation:
有一個名為帕拉迪亞姆的世界，由黑翼之神與白翼之神統治。那裡過去曾經統一，如今卻分裂為兩個地區。主角艾爾一直生活在孤兒院。某天，他離開孤兒院後倒在路邊，被一名叫溫特維特的男子救下。對方自稱是艾爾的哥哥，並提議由艾爾把失散的兄弟們重新聚在一起……
